evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Vous rédigez des codes propres, faciles à maintenir et vous documentez minutieusement votre travail
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities repeatedly emphasize technical audits, documentation, data consistency analysis and monitoring, with no shipping-speed language, making this rigour-dominant.
evidence.domain_risk: Analyse de cohérence des données et mise en place de monitoring
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: This is a data/cloud consultancy serving large enterprise clients (Auchan, EDF, LVMH) without financial-reporting or regulatory-specific language, placing it at moderate risk.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Notre singularité tient à un modèle qui privilégie l'expertise sur le volume : des équipes pluridisciplinaires resserrées, et un lab interne
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The firm is an established consultancy with a mature internal R&D lab, senior ex-Google experts, and multiple structured practices, indicating a mature organization.
evidence.jd_authorship: Vous maîtrisez la construction d'une Data platform, d'un Data lake et d'une Data warehouse dans Google cloud platform... Vous maîtriser les étapes de Data transformations modernes via DBT et/ou Dataform
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The JD names precise tools (BigQuery, dbt, Dataform, Python) and concrete tasks (audits, pipeline construction, CDP deployment) that describe exactly what the person does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Construction de Data platform (ingestion, transformation, monitoring ...) dans des environnements cloud
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The core work is building data platforms and pipelines themselves for client organizations, an internal-data-function orientation rather than a specific business domain.
evidence.autonomy_level: Project Lead: Gestion de projet autonome et garant de la qualité de service... Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines strategic project leadership, mentoring, and proactive business partnering with hands-on delivery execution (pipelines, audits), a genuinely mixed autonomy profile.
evidence.ai_role: Nous encourageons et formons nos collaborateurs à l'utilisation de plusieurs services d'Intelligence artificiel (Gemini, Open AI, Claude …) afin d'optimiser leur condition de travail
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The company explicitly trains and encourages consultants to use AI tools (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude) to optimize their own work, making the candidate an AI tool user rather than a builder of AI-consuming infrastructure.
evidence.testing_framing: Analyse de cohérence des données et mise en place de monitoring
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data consistency checks and monitoring appear as named tasks in the delivery list but without an explicit ownership/definition framing of a testing practice, so tool_listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Analyse de cohérence des données et mise en place de monitoring
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Data consistency and monitoring concerns are named as delivery tasks but are secondary to the broader consulting delivery scope, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Construction / Evolution d'architectures techniques cloud... Vous êtes capables d'intervenir sur des pipeline de données complexes déjà existants
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role explicitly spans both building new architectures/platforms and intervening on complex existing pipelines, a mixed signal.
evidence.language_gate: Très bon niveau en Français et en Anglais
